content:
**Ribeye Steak** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A cut of Brahmin Meat which has been cooked to improve its safety and nutritional value. Consuming it will give a moderate boost to Carry Weight and restore a large amount of hunger and health at the cost of a moderate amount of rads.

Cooking one Ribeye Steak is required during the quest Second Helpings.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Brahmin Meat (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Brahmin Meat | | Ribeye Steak (1) | 

- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after picking up Brahmin Meat for the first time.
- May be bought from Mr Waiter or Ms Waitress at the dining room inside the Whitespring Resort.
- Can be awarded upon completing the daily quest Daily: Thrill of the Grill.
